srFocusHint: Data table alternative — keyboard focus expands this table in place
ganttCaption: Gantt turn chart data: prefill and decode times, context sizes, and cumulative walltime per turn
compareCaption: Hardware comparison data: speeds, timings, and cost for System A versus System B with the advantage ratio

distributionCaption: Walltime distribution: prefill versus decode time and their share of the total request walltime

itlHistogramCaption: ITL distribution histogram: token count per inter-token-latency bin in milliseconds
